name: jrebirth-processor-modules
description: Explain and implement JRebirth annotation processor module startup: generated ModuleStarter classes, @Preload, @BootComponent, @RegistrationPoint, @Register, JPMS provides declarations, ServiceLoader discovery, and SPI-style component implementation management. Use when a module starter is missing, generated source is unresolved, preloading does not happen, or component implementations need registration and priority ordering.
